 Print FMGE October 2026 admit card released The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) has released the admit card for the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE) October 2026 session. Candidates who registered for the examination can now download their hall tickets from the official website, natboard.edu.in. The FMGE October 2026 examination is scheduled to be held on October 31. Candidates must download their admit cards before the examination and check all the details mentioned on them. The admit card is mandatory for entry into the examination centre. The examination city intimation slip was released on October 20. Candidates should check their allotted examination centre and reporting time before the test. FMGE October 2026 admit card : How to download
 Candidates can follow these steps to download their admit cards: Visit the official NBEMS website, natboard.edu.in.
 Go to the examinations section and select FMGE.
 Open the application link for the October 2026 session.
 Click on the login option.
 Enter the required user ID, password and captcha code.
 Open the FMGE October 2026 admit card link.
 Download the hall ticket and take a printout for the examination day.
 Direct link here. Candidates should keep their login details ready to access the admit card without any difficulty. Details to check on the FMGE admit card
 After downloading the hall ticket, candidates should carefully check the following details: Candidate's name
 Roll number
 Application ID
 Date of birth
 Photograph
 Examination centre address
 Reporting time
 If candidates find any errors in the details, they should report them to NBEMS for clarification. FMGE 2026: Important instructions for candidates
 The FMGE is a screening examination for foreign medical graduates seeking medical registration in India. Candidates appearing for the October 2026 session should carry a printed copy of their admit card and a valid photo identity proof to the examination centre. They should also follow the reporting time and other instructions mentioned on the hall ticket. Candidates are advised to check the official NBEMS website regularly for further updates related to the examination.
